summaries: Marcus finds his long-lost military friend Toby Wren shivering and amnesiac on the freezing moors. Sensing severe danger, he carries him down the mountain to seek urgent medical attention.

Dr. Nair confirms Toby is suffering from a dangerous high fever and unresponsive pupils, while two tense Aldersgate representatives arrive demanding his release. Marcus flatly refuses to let them take him, but Toby's condition begins to rapidly deteriorate.

Toby's extreme fever causes him to snap his restraints and violently attack a nurse. As the hospital alarms begin to blare, Priya realizes the virus is spreading rapidly through bodily fluids and urges an immediate lockdown.
Lockdown fails at the hospital as the infected nurse turns, forcing Marcus, Priya, Gaz, and Peggy to flee in an ambulance. As they speed away, an Aldersgate van races toward the abandoned facility.

After their ambulance runs out of fuel at Begum Motors, the group survives an attack by Fatima's turned apprentice, whom Gaz traps inside the garage. During the chaos, Jamie suffers a scratch on her left forearm, leaving Priya horrified as Fatima reveals her brother Imran has vanished.

Priya bound Jamie's scratch and ordered her kept under constant watch through the night while Fatima repaired the ambulance's fuel lines. Tensions boiled over as Marcus questioned Priya about Toby's military connections and Gaz clashed with Fatima over leaving before Peggy restored order.

As the battery radio confirms the military cordon around Sheffield, Jamie passes the eight-hour mark with no sign of fever. Their relief is cut short when a faint, synchronized humming begins to drift across the yard from the darkness outside.

Escaping the surrounded garage through an underground drainage pit, the survivors emerge into the foggy dawn lane just as BBC Radio Sheffield goes dark. Armed with Rhea's final broadcast instructions, the group sets out on foot toward the Haven sanctuary at the old Ashop water works.

The ambulance breaks down on the high moor road, forcing the survivors to continue on foot to an army checkpoint. Faced with rifles and a harsh loudspeaker order from Major Hargreaves, Marcus argues fiercely before being forced to halt.

Major Hargreaves warns Marcus that the army has orders to burn the valley clean if containment fails within the week. She directs them toward Haven, adding that the camp is operated by Aldersgate under government contract.

Resting in an abandoned farmhouse, the survivors share lingering trauma and secrets while bonding over shared grief. Their quiet moment is cut short when they pick up a nearby high-frequency radio signal filtering through the dusk light.

Following a crackling ham radio signal into an attic, the survivors recruit Ollie, a panicked radio enthusiast who has been recording coded transmissions. They learn that a local scientist named Linnea is broadcasting from near the mill, prompting Marcus to move the group toward her location.

MARCUS.visible: wet mountain rescue gear, red outer jacket on, sweat-stained
MARCUS.knows: Sheffield studio fell on air; Haven reception centre is at Ashop water works; military will firebomb the valley if containment fails; Haven is run by Aldersgate; heard radio static down the lane; a scientist named Linnea is broadcasting coded messages near the mill.

PRIYA.visible: hospital scrubs under a beige waxed jacket, rain-streaked face
PRIYA.knows: Jamie was scratched; army is enforcing strict quarantine; Haven is linked to Aldersgate; hid prior knowledge of Aldersgate trials.

TOBY.visible: hospital gown, army greatcoat, bare feet, broken wrist restraints
TOBY.knows: nothing, completely consumed by the fever and instinct to attack.

GAZ.knows: they must flee the valley immediately; military has live weapons drawn; admitted he froze during police career.

FATIMA.visible: grease-stained mechanics coveralls, wet hair, smudge of dark engine grease on hands
FATIMA.knows: her sister Naomi is stranded in Sheffield; ambulance is dead; army checkpoint blocks the road; abandoned her brother Imran; a scientist named Linnea is broadcasting near the mill.

LINNEA.carries: orange sample case, hidden satellite phone

JAMIE.visible: torn jacket sleeve on left forearm, freshly re-bandaged scratch on left forearm
JAMIE.knows: she passed eight hours without fever; army has blocked the road; detected nearby high-frequency broadcast originating near the mill.

PEGGY.visible: fresh white plaster cast on left wrist
PEGGY.knows: Marcus won't leave her behind; army is stopping all traffic; late husband worked on Ashop tunnels.

OLLIE.visible: orange running shoes, headset draped on neck
OLLIE.knows: monitoring coded transmissions from a scientist named Linnea near the mill who speaks of an archive

HARGREAVES.knows: valleys are marked for a clean burn if containment fails.
